The '''bartender''' is a [[Fallout TV series#Cast and characters|character]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Trap]]===
This man works at a bar in [[Los Angeles]], serving the [[Bar patron (TV series)|bar patrons]], when [[Cooper Howard]] and [[Charles Whiteknife]] meet and talk about [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]]. After Whiteknife leaves, Cooper speaks to the bartender, ordering another drink.

==Appearances==
The unnamed bartender appears only {{In|FOTV}}.
{{FOTV appearances|6=106}}
